data: Modern Soyuz workhorse for ISS crew + cargo

Fleet launcher entry added to wire up modernised Soyuz-2 (2.1a/2.1b/2.1v Fregat) cross-references for the LauncherFlightsWidget (Option 4 follow-up to #306). Older Soyuz-FG / Soyuz-U variants have their own fleet entries.
Modern Soyuz workhorse — carries Soyuz MS crew + Progress MS cargo to the ISS

RKTs Progress's modernised Soyuz family, with digital flight controls replacing the analogue systems of Soyuz-FG / Soyuz-U. Variants 2.1a (RD-107A/RD-108A first stage + RD-0124 third stage), 2.1b (uprated third stage), and 2.1v (no boosters, single RD-110 stage). Carries every modern Russian crewed and cargo flight to the ISS plus Glonass, Resurs-P, and Lotos-S payloads.
Successor to Proton-K; modernised heavy lift
Soviet Moon rocket; four launches all failed
The Soviet / Russian heavy-lift workhorse 1967-2012 — Salyut, Mir, Venera, Vega, Luna sample-return
